answer: At first payout, the holder harvests one crate of grapes from a registered ridge vineyard on umber soil, the vintner signing the harvest record and measuring the must's nectar sweetness. Two verifiers match crate and record against the register within a week; a crate claimed twice or a record matching no harvest closes both. One crate costs 750,000 rupiah, so one holder pays once while a thousand fakes need a thousand crates, 750 million.
